courts.highest: Court of Appeal or Cour d'Appel (composition NA)
courts.judges: judges assigned from France for 3 years
courts.lower: Court of the First Instance or Tribunal de Première Instance; Court of Administrative Law or Tribunal Administratif
courts.note: appeals beyond the French Polynesia Court of Appeal are heard by the Court of Cassation (in Paris)

gov.type: parliamentary democracy (Assembly of French Polynesia); an overseas collectivity of France

executive.chosen: French president directly elected by absolute-majority popular vote in 2 rounds, if needed, for a 5-year term (eligible for a second term); high commissioner appointed by the French president on the advice of the French Ministry of Interior; French Polynesia president indirectly elected by Assembly of French Polynesia for a 5-year term (no term limits)
executive.cabinet: Council of Ministers approved by the Assembly from a list of its members submitted by the president

legislature.name: Assembly of French Polynesia (Assemblée de la Polynésie française)

chambers.name: Assembly of French Polynesia (Assemblée de la Polynésie française)

gov.divisions: 5 administrative subdivisions (subdivisions administratives, singular - subdivision administrative): Iles Australes (Austral Islands), Iles du Vent (Windward Islands), Iles Marquises (Marquesas Islands), Iles Sous-le-Vent (Leeward Islands), Iles Tuamotu-Gambier
